csv_project_name: DB for Animal Control Facility Roof Replacement
csv_agency: City of Waterbury Public Works Department
csv_scope_of_work: The Project consists of all work, including design build services, and equipment and materials required for the removal and replacement of the existing roofing system for the Animal Control Facility located at 200 Municipal Road in Waterbury, CT. The Animal Control Facility was built around 1999. The building s roof area is approximately 5,600 SF, and consists of a shingle roof. There is also a side shed that requires the existing roof removed and replaced with asphalt shingles. The City requires a new high-quality durable roof with a 30-year warranty that will provide long-term trouble-free service for staff and users of the Animal Control Facility

title: Design-Build for Animal Control Facility Roof Replacement
short_description: Design-build roof replacement for a small animal control facility in Waterbury, Connecticut.
project_scope: Removal and replacement of the existing roofing system for the Animal Control Facility, built around 1999, at 200 Municipal Road in Waterbury, Connecticut. The main building roof area is approximately 5,600 square feet and currently consists of a shingle roof. A side shed also requires removal of the existing roof and replacement with asphalt shingles. The city requires a durable new roof with a 30-year warranty.
services: Design-build services including design, removal of existing roofing, replacement roofing works, and provision of all required equipment and materials.
relevance_explanation:
- Small roof replacement project with very limited structural complexity.
- Scope is primarily roofing replacement, not bridge, long-span, special structure, or complex building engineering.
- No indication of innovative structural design, lightweight systems, or sustainability features relevant to sbp.
- Design-build component exists, but the technical scope remains minor and not aligned with sbp's core focus.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. Available quantity information for estimation: approximately 5,600 SF shingle roof plus one side shed roof; replacement includes removal and new asphalt shingles with 30-year warranty. Based on typical small public-building reroofing costs, a rough order-of-magnitude could be in the low six figures, but this is too uncertain to report as a realistic plain-number estimate.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. The tender is design-build for a small reroofing project; any engineering/design fee would likely be minor and embedded in the contractor's offer, so no reliable estimate can be derived from the source alone.
references_qualifications: Design-build services requested. Mandatory pre-submittal meeting. No explicit reference or qualification requirements are stated in the provided source excerpt.
